# `org.create`

Create an organization

Session-only. The creator joins the owners team, which holds admin on every org repository.

- Method and path: `POST /new/org`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie org create`
- MCP: `org_create`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |

| `display_name` | body | no | `string` |
| `name` | body | yes | `string` |
| `visibility` | body | no | `string` |
